newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 11.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average on Tuesday blasted through the 7,500-point mark to end at a record 7,539, up 61.
* The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index ended 6.84 points lower at 1,110.36 on Tuesday.
* Chartists said the Composite Index could be heading lower, towards 1,099, its recent low. If that happened it could head towards 1,089 or lower, they said.
* After Tuesday's fall, focus on finance stocks, led by merger candidate Suria Capital
* Market unlikely to pick up volumes as overseas as well as local institutional orders remain thin, dealers say
* Ekran rights issue announcement awaited, which could affect all companies run by its chairman Ting Pek Khiing
* "The market is very, very quiet. It looks like it is going to be this way for some time," said the head of research at a foreign brokerage.
